parameters.jsCode: const demo = [{source:'LinkedIn',messageId:'demo-001',title:'Senior Solutions Engineer',company:'Acme Cloud',url:'https://example.com/acme-se',locationRaw:'Paris, France',workModel:'hybrid',salaryMin:85000,salaryMax:100000,currency:'EUR',seniority:'senior',description:'Customer-facing technical discovery, cloud APIs, demos and POCs.'},{source:'Indeed',messageId:'demo-002',title:'Sales Engineer',company:'Northstar Data',url:'https://example.com/northstar',locationRaw:'Remote EU',workModel:'remote',salaryMin:70000,salaryMax:90000,currency:'EUR',seniority:'mid',description:'Technical demos, data integrations, stakeholder communication.'}]; return demo.map(j=>({json:j}));

const weights={technical_fit:20,customer_facing_fit:20,seniority_fit:10,location_fit:15,remote_hybrid_fit:10,salary_fit:10,relocation_visa_fit:5,company_domain_fit:10}; const preferred=['Paris / Île-de-France','Remote EU','London / UK','Dublin / Ireland','Berlin / Germany','Amsterdam / Netherlands','Remote France']; const out=[]; for (const item of $input.all()) { const j=item.json; const text=(j.title+' '+j.description).toLowerCase(); const location=j.locationRaw.toLowerCase().includes('paris')?'Paris / Île-de-France':j.locationRaw.toLowerCase().includes('remote eu')?'Remote EU':'Other'; const s={technical_fit:/api|cloud|integration|data/.test(text)?95:60,customer_facing_fit:/customer|demo|discovery|stakeholder|poc/.test(text)?95:60,seniority_fit:['mid','senior'].includes(j.seniority)?100:50,location_fit:preferred.includes(location)?100:40,remote_hybrid_fit:/remote|hybrid/.test(j.workModel)?100:50,salary_fit:j.salaryMin?90:0,relocation_visa_fit:100,company_domain_fit:80}; const total=Math.round(Object.entries(weights).reduce((sum,[k,w])=>sum+s[k]*w/100,0)); out.push({json:{...j,jobKey:(j.url||j.company+'|'+j.title+'|'+location).toLowerCase(),locationBucket:location,...s,totalScore:total,recommendation:total>=80?'Apply now':total>=65?'Worth reviewing':'Review later',hardFlags:j.salaryMin?[]:['salary missing'],status:'new'}}); } return out;

const groups={}; for (const {json:j} of $input.all()) (groups[j.locationBucket]??=[]).push(j); const html=Object.entries(groups).map(([loc,jobs])=>'

'+loc+'

    '+jobs.map(j=>'
  1. '+j.totalScore+'/100 — '+j.title+' at '+j.company+'
    '+j.recommendation+' · '+j.workModel+' · view listing
    2. ').join('')+'
').join(''); return [{json:{subject:'Job pipeline digest — '+new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB'),html}}];
